usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and orders, and Missive keeps the shopper as a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Missive
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left with an email becomes a contact your team can write to.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the contact appears after a scheduled check, not at the moment someone leaves.
